@[to_additive]
lemma pairwise_div_notMem_range [InvolutiveInv ι]
    (v : ι → G) (hv_one : ∀ i, v i ≠ 1) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
    (t : Set ι) (hv_t : ∀ i, i ∈ t ∨ i⁻¹ ∈ t) :
    {i | IsMulIndecomposable v t i}.Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v := by
  intro i hi j hj hne
  by_contra! ⟨k, hk⟩
  rcases hv_t k with hk' | hk'
  · simpa [hv_one] using hi.2 k hk' j hj.1 (by simp [hk])
  · simpa [hv_one] using hj.2 k⁻¹ hk' i hi.1 (by simp [hv_inv, hk])

@[to_additive]
lemma pairwise_baseOf_div_notMem [InvolutiveInv ι] [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
    (f : G →* S) (hf : ∀ i, f (v i) ≠ 1) :
    (baseOf v f).Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v :=
  pairwise_div_notMem_range v (fun i h ↦ hf i (by simp [h])) hv_inv _
    fun i ↦ by simpa [hv_inv] using (hf i).symm
